account.riskPolicy: existing BOO risk-policy/risk-budget plus operator-tightened limits

candidates.name: ROLLING_CROSS_SECTIONAL_PULLBACK_QUALITY
candidates.hypothesis: Selecting a broad upper cross-section of fast recovery relative to pullback depth is more robust than stacking absolute candle and flow gates.
rules: use only completed setup and trigger state available at trigger time
rank the score against completed setup scores in the trailing seven days, including equal-time queue peers but no later timestamp
accept score percentile >= 0.60 as the only new gate
enter at the existing trigger's next open with unchanged structural stop and account protections

holdoutPolicy: Do not open walk-forward or reserved holdout unless C31 passes every development gate.
